description: Scientific claim auditing with 7-section canonical reports. Audits a text claim against a corpus of artifacts using keyword overlap, channel-aware evidence extraction, and fail-closed verdict policy. Verdict scale: SUPPORTED / PARTIALLY SUPPORTED / WEAKLY SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED / UNCERTAIN. All outputs: LOCAL_LAB_ONLY — not external proof.
function: Claim decomposition, evidence extraction, audit report generation (7-section canonical format)

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: List of file or directory paths to load as corpus

inputs.name: add_conversation_source
inputs.description: If True, add the claim itself as an unstable source

inputs.name: top_k
inputs.description: Max number of evidence slices to return (default: 20)

inputs.name: claims
inputs.description: List of {title, claim} dicts for batch_audit

outputs.name: load_artifacts
outputs.description: Loaded (path, text) pairs and source records

outputs.name: assess_proposition
outputs.description: Support score, status, and supporting/opposing excerpts

outputs.name: detect_logical_contradictions
outputs.description: List of detected lexical contradiction descriptions

outputs.name: inspect_document
outputs.description: Audit report for document inspection without explicit claim

outputs.name: validate_canonical_report
outputs.description: Validation result and list of missing sections/fields

outputs.name: batch_audit
outputs.description: Summary dict with rows, verdict distribution, and confidence stats

public_api.name: VERDICTS
public_api.description: Ordered verdict scale: SUPPORTED / PARTIALLY SUPPORTED / WEAKLY SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED / UNCERTAIN

public_api.name: WEAKNESS_TYPES
public_api.description: Valid weakness types: Logical Contradiction, Observational Tension, Assumption Dependence, Explanatory Limit

public_api.name: STATUSES
public_api.description: Weakness statuses: Established, Contested, Speculative

public_api.name: SEVERITIES
public_api.description: Weakness severities: High, Medium, Low

public_api.name: CAUSES
public_api.description: Probable causes: Data, Measurement, Modeling, Parameters, New Physics

public_api.name: STRICT_SECTIONS
public_api.description: 7 required section headings for canonical audit reports

public_api.name: SourceRecord
public_api.description: Dataclass representing an input artifact source. render() returns formatted string.

public_api.name: EvidenceSlice
public_api.description: Dataclass representing one scored evidence sentence from a source.

public_api.name: Weakness
public_api.signature: Weakness(type, status, severity, probable_cause, discriminant_test, basis=None)
public_api.description: Dataclass for audit weakness entry. validate() checks field constraints. render(idx) returns micro-syntax string.

public_api.name: PropositionAssessment
public_api.description: Dataclass for assessed proposition with support score and evidence excerpts.

public_api.name: AuditReport
public_api.description: Full 7-section audit report dataclass. validate() checks constraints. render_markdown() returns canonical markdown. to_dict() returns serializable dict.

public_api.name: load_artifacts
public_api.signature: load_artifacts(inputs: Sequence[str], max_chars_per_file: int = 25000) -> Tuple[List, List[SourceRecord]]
public_api.description: Load text content from files/directories. Returns (loaded_pairs, sources).

public_api.name: extract_evidence
public_api.signature: extract_evidence(claim: str, artifacts: List[Tuple[Path, str]], top_k: int = 20) -> List[EvidenceSlice]
public_api.description: Extract and rank evidence sentences from artifacts against a claim.

public_api.name: decompose_claim
public_api.description: Decompose a compound claim into testable propositions.

public_api.name: assess_proposition
public_api.description: Assess support level for one proposition against evidence slices.

public_api.name: detect_logical_contradictions
public_api.description: Scan combined text for lexical contradiction pairs.

public_api.name: audit_claim
public_api.signature: audit_claim(claim: str, title: str, inputs: Sequence[str] = (), *, add_conversation_source: bool = False) -> AuditReport
public_api.description: Audit a claim against a corpus of artifacts. Returns AuditReport.

public_api.name: inspect_document
public_api.description: Inspect a document corpus without an explicit claim. Returns AuditReport.

public_api.name: validate_canonical_report
public_api.description: Check that a rendered markdown report contains all 7 required sections.

public_api.name: batch_audit
public_api.signature: batch_audit(claims: List[Dict], inputs: Sequence[str] = ()) -> Dict[str, Any]
public_api.description: Run audit_claim on a list of {title, claim} dicts. Returns summary dict.
